mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cardrec (sno, originCardNo, newCardNo, opType) VALUES (#{sno}, #{originCardNo}, #{newCardNo}, #{opType})
mapper.select: SELECT serNum, sno, originCardNo, newCardNo, opType FROM cardrec WHERE sno = #{sno} ORDER BY serNum DESC

SELECT cr.serNum, cr.sno, s.username AS studentName, cr.originCardNo, cr.newCardNo, CASE cr.opType WHEN '新办' THEN 1 WHEN '挂失' THEN 2 WHEN '补办' THEN 3 WHEN '注销' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS opType FROM cardrec cr LEFT JOIN student s ON cr.sno = s.sno
AND cr.opType = #{opType} AND cr.sno LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sno}, '%')
ORDER BY cr.serNum DESC
